CustomField.formula: (5 * ( FLOOR( ( BLANKVALUE(DATEVALUE(Work_Item_Closed_Date__c), TODAY()) - DATE(1900, 1, 8) ) / 7 ) - FLOOR( ( DATEVALUE(CreatedDate) - DATE(1900, 1, 8) ) / 7 ) ) + MIN( 5, MOD( BLANKVALUE(DATEVALUE(Work_Item_Closed_Date__c), TODAY()) - DATE(1900, 1, 8), 7 ) ) - MIN( 5, MOD( DATEVALUE(CreatedDate) - DATE(1900, 1, 8), 7 ) ) )
CustomField.label: Days Open
